claims: XRP Insights' latest accessible pinned observation remains ledger 108037957 at 2026-11-01 04:35 UTC; it reports 1B XRP released, zero re-escrow by that ledger, and 1B XRP net outside escrow at that cutoff.
The tracker reports a rolling 12-cycle re-escrow ratio of 64.2% (7.7B of 12B XRP re-escrowed); November's cycle remains incomplete.
Binance Update #4 reports approximately 95% aggregate incident replenishment and includes XRP among ten assets the company says are 100% backed.
Binance's 06:00–09:00 UTC November 1 phase-one withdrawal window includes XRP and is progressive. At 06:15 UTC, actual XRP withdrawal availability remained unconfirmed.

The official Binance network-status page was rechecked at 06:10 UTC; it still displayed last-updated 05:28:24 AM (timezone undisclosed) and a server-rendered 'No records' table. This does not establish that XRP withdrawals are open or suspended.
PR #1444 current head 8d8965e passed exact-head CI with 363 tests and 8 subtests and its fail-closed gate; it remains open, draft and unmerged, one commit behind current main.
PR #1445 current head ac04af6 passed exact-head CI with 346 tests and 8 subtests and its fail-closed gate; it remains open, draft and unmerged, based on current main 694fc424.

PR #1445's first head failed one assertion because a test matched the literal HF_TOKEN in explanatory disabled-workflow text; the test was corrected to check actual secret references/environment assignments, and the current head passed.
Main remains at 694fc4241f543917fc6eb787c025bf1eb6726595. PR #1443 passed 349 tests plus 8 subtests; PR #1444 passed 363 plus 8; PR #1445 passed 346 plus 8. All three remain open/draft/unmerged.

The current main workflow inventory still includes scheduled issue-mutating paths: auto-resolve-issues, barrot-autonomous-resolver, daily-digest and self-schedule; gumroad-metrics also commits aggregate metrics to main on a schedule.
Barrot Autonomous Resolver reads vars.COPILOT_ASSIGNEE and can assign unassigned issues and PRs when configured; the variable value and any live Copilot handoff have not been verified.

The barrot-pr-automerge workflow is disabled; no automatic PR merge capability was found in that workflow. The separate Merge Queue is covered by PR #1443 but remains active on main until approval/merge.
